articles.headline: Jerome scores 27 points as Grizzlies improve to 5-0 on road by routing short-handed Raptors 118-102
articles.description: — Ty Jerome scored 27 points, Cameron Boozer added 22 and the Memphis Grizzlies improved to 5-0 on the road this season by beating the short-handed Toronto Raptors 118-102 on Monday night.

articles.headline: Collins puts up 24 points and 10 rebounds as Pistons beat Davis and Wizards, 122-111
articles.description: — John Collins had 24 points and 10 rebounds as the Detroit Pistons beat the Washington Wizards 122-111 on Monday at Little Caesars Arena.

articles.headline: Luka Doncic powers the Lakers past the Hawks, stretching the win streak to 6
articles.description: — Luka Doncic had 32 points, eight rebounds and 10 assists and the Los Angeles Lakers extended their winning streak to six games with a 124-114 win over the Atlanta Hawks on Monday night.
